instructions: At least 4 hours ahead, or the night before: line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk the 2 cups Greek yogurt, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth.
Spread it over the parchment with a spatula in an even layer about 1/4 inch thick, roughly 9 by 13 inches.
Hull half the strawberries and slice them thin.
Scatter the sliced strawberries, half the blueberries and the 2 tbsp mini chocolate chips over the yogurt, pressing them in lightly.
Put the sheet flat in the freezer for at least 4 hours, until the bark is hard all the way through.
Lift it out on the parchment and break it into pieces with your hands, or cut it with a sharp knife. This makes about 24 pieces.
Eat it straight from the freezer. It goes soft within about 10 minutes at room temperature, so keep the rest in a sealed freezer bag in the freezer for up to 2 weeks.
advance_prep_notes: Make and freeze the bark at least 4 hours ahead, or the night before.
method_notes: All three whisk Greek yogurt with a little honey or maple syrup, spread it thin on parchment, scatter toppings and freeze it until hard. Chocolate Covered Katie (the lead) uses 2 cups yogurt, 2 tbsp sweetener and 1 tsp vanilla with strawberries, blueberries and chocolate chips, freezes it for 4 hours and breaks it into 24 pieces. Tasting Table uses the same yogurt and honey with mixed berries, granola and almonds and keeps it frozen for up to 2 weeks; Bigger Bolder Baking adds more vanilla and swirls in richer toppings. This follows the lead with honey as the sweetener and Tasting Table's keeping time.
